hints.title: Approved Transactions and Chargebacks Union
hints.text: Unify approved transaction events and chargeback events into a single timeline keyed by event month and transaction country.

hints.title: Dual Event Tagging with Conditional Sums
hints.text: Select approved transactions and join chargebacks to transactions to retrieve their country. Tag event types, then group by month and country.

hints.title: Monthly Chargebacks Blueprint
hints.text: Union approved events with chargeback events. Group by month and country, aggregating approved count/amount and chargeback count/amount.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
WITH Unified AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_FORMAT(trans_date, '%Y-%m') AS month,
        country,
        amount,
        'approved' AS type
    FROM Transactions
    WHERE state = 'approved'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        DATE_FORMAT(c.trans_date, '%Y-%m') AS month,
        t.country,
        t.amount,
        'chargeback' AS type
    FROM Chargebacks c
    JOIN Transactions t ON c.trans_id = t.id
)
SELECT 
    month,
    country,
    SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'approved' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS approved_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'chargeback' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chargeback_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'chargeback' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS chargeback_amount
FROM Unified
GROUP BY month, country;
```

complexity.notes: Union of tagged approved and chargeback records followed by two-key grouping runs in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Separate outer joins on date strings easily produce Cartesian duplicate rows when multiple transactions share a date.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Union all normalizes distinct event streams into a single homogeneous pipeline before aggregation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of UNION ALL to normalize approved and chargeback streams and conditional SUM aggregations.

WITH Unified AS (
    SELECT 
        TO_CHAR(trans_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
        country,
        amount,
        'approved' AS type
    FROM Transactions
    WHERE state = 'approved'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        TO_CHAR(c.trans_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
        t.country,
        t.amount,
        'chargeback' AS type
    FROM Chargebacks c
    JOIN Transactions t ON c.trans_id = t.id
)
SELECT 
    month,
    country,
    SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'approved' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS approved_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'chargeback' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chargeback_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'chargeback' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS chargeback_amount
FROM Unified
GROUP BY month, country;

import pandas as pd

def monthly_transactions(transactions: pd.DataFrame, chargebacks: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    app = transactions[transactions['state'] == 'approved'].copy()
    app['month'] = app['trans_date'].astype(str).str.slice(0, 7)
    app['type'] = 'approved'
    app_stream = app[['month', 'country', 'amount', 'type']]

    cb = chargebacks.merge(transactions, left_on='trans_id', right_on='id')
    cb['month'] = cb['trans_date_x'].astype(str).str.slice(0, 7)
    cb['type'] = 'chargeback'
    cb_stream = cb[['month', 'country', 'amount', 'type']]

    unified = pd.concat([app_stream, cb_stream])
    res = unified.groupby(['month', 'country']).agg(
        approved_count=('type', lambda x: (x == 'approved').sum()),
        approved_amount=('amount', lambda x: x[unified.loc[x.index, 'type'] == 'approved'].sum()),
        chargeback_count=('type', lambda x: (x == 'chargeback').sum()),
        chargeback_amount=('amount', lambda x: x[unified.loc[x.index, 'type'] == 'chargeback'].sum())
    ).reset_index()
    return res
solutions.approach: Pandas Concat Event Streams with Conditional Reductions
